positions.statement: The Tillamook County Pioneer reported in August 2026 that the bills Melisa Finkle hopes to develop include proposals related to short- and long-term care safety, rural infrastructure, and emergency preparedness.
positions.excerpt: proposals related to short‑ and long‑term care safety, rural infrastructure, and emergency preparedness

verification.note: Original statement named only the care-safety item from a three-part list in the excerpt; reworded to include all three and to name Finkle in full. Attributed to the Pioneer (editor byline, no named author); the article says her public-sector oversight background shapes the bills. Article dated 2026-08-18; she is an independent candidate for SD 16. T3 acceptable.

verification_summary.balance_notes: Race or-senate-16 swept 2026-10-19 with the same issue list and stop rules for all three candidates. Bangs: 11 T2 from a full campaign priorities page; Finkle: 1 T3 (no campaign site found); Armitage: 2 T3 (Pioneer filing story). Counts reflect available material, not unequal effort; pamphlet statements (T1) not yet collected for any of the three.
